homeAbout.title: About Us
paragraphs: Humbl Pilates is a boutique reformer pilates studio in the heart of Pererenan, Bali. We move beyond the standard reformer experience with precision, quality and truly personalised instruction.

Our membership-first model and intentionally small classes create the space for focused, individualised attention - allowing each client to progress confidently in strength, mobility and alignment. Our Humbl method is designed to leave you feeling centred, balanced and empowered.
homeAbout.founderParagraph: Founder and lead instructor Demi Geary brings Pilates teaching and experience in health, fitness and education. Her approach blends biomechanical principles, human movement and contemporary Pilates to create technically precise yet transformative sessions. Humbl Pilates embodies her signature style of an inclusive, home-like space where clients feel seen, supported and inspired as they build strength, alignment and a deeper mind-body connection.

levels.name: Find Your Passion
levels.description: Start your Pilates journey in a supportive & beginner-friendly space designed to help you build strength, improve technique, and boost confidence. Through a range of modern and classical exercises, you'll focus on core strength, posture, and balance to enhance overall mobility. But don’t be fooled—while this class is beginner-friendly, you’ll still leave with that signature Humbl burn. More than just movement, this class encourages you to listen to your body and celebrate its progress. Leave feeling strong, capable, and empowered in your own skin!

levels.name: Find Your Humbl
levels.description: This dynamic, full-body class is perfect for those looking to build on their Pilates foundation. Designed for confident beginners and seasoned enthusiasts, you'll challenge both small and large muscle groups while refining strength, technique, and flexibility. Expect a balanced mix of flowing movements and focused exercises that leave you feeling empowered, centered, and connected after each session. Prior Pilates experience recommended.

levels.name: Find Your Power
levels.description: Challenge your strength, balance, and endurance in this dynamic, full-body workout designed for those ready to level up. Using a mix of functional exercises, spring resistance, and stability work, you’ll build muscular strength, control, and confidence. This class is also designed to boost your mental toughness and self-awareness, helping you develop a stronger sense of confidence and self-assurance. Leave feeling strong, empowered, and unstoppable. Prior Pilates experience required.

faq_pricingPage.a: We require a minimum of 8 hours’ notice to cancel a class via the app. As a small studio, every space matters. Cancellations made outside of this window will not be credited. If you cancel within the 8-hour policy, your class will be returned to your account as a credit.

faq_pricingPage.q: Can I book a class and pay later?
faq_pricingPage.a: No. Due to our very limited class sizes, all bookings must be paid for at the time of booking—either online or via direct payment at the studio. Spaces cannot be held without payment.

faq_pricingPage.q: How long does the Intro Package last?
faq_pricingPage.a: Our Intro Package is valid for two weeks from your first booked class.

faq_pricingPage.q: I’m new to Pilates — which class should I start with?
faq_pricingPage.a: We recommend starting with Find Your Passion, our beginner-friendly class. This class is designed to guide you through the foundational principles of Pilates in a supportive environment, helping you build strength, confidence, and technique.

faq_pricingPage.q: How long are packages valid for?
faq_pricingPage.a: Package validity depends on the option you choose: 10 Class Pack: valid for 6 months; 5 Class Pack: valid for 3 months; Single Casual Class: valid for 1 month

Yes. We have a strict no socks, no entry policy. Grip socks are essential for hygiene, safety, and proper technique on the equipment. They are available for purchase at the studio, priced between 75,000 IDR – 250,000 IDR.

faq_pricingPage.q: Can I join if I am pregnant?
faq_pricingPage.a: Yes. Find Your Passion is the most suitable class during pregnancy. Our studio is small and intimate, allowing us to offer personalised modifications so you feel supported, comfortable, and safe throughout your practice.

Getting Started.q: Do I need prior Pilates experience?
Getting Started.a: Not at all! We welcome complete beginners. Our Beginner group classes and private sessions are designed to introduce you to the fundamentals in a supportive, non-intimidating environment. Demi will guide you through proper technique and help you build a strong foundation.

Wear comfortable, fitted athletic clothing that allows you to move freely. Avoid loose or baggy clothing as it can get caught in the reformer equipment. We practice barefoot or in grip socks (available for purchase at the studio).
Just yourself and a water bottle! We provide all equipment including mats, props, and towels. If you have your own mat or prefer to use grip socks, you're welcome to bring those.

Getting Started.q: How do I book my first class?
Getting Started.a: You can book through our website, WhatsApp, or by calling the studio directly. We recommend arriving 10 minutes early for your first class so we can give you a brief studio tour and answer any questions.

Getting Started.q: Is Pilates suitable for injuries or physical limitations?
Getting Started.a: Pilates is excellent for rehabilitation and working with injuries, but we recommend starting with a private session so we can assess your needs and create appropriate modifications. Always consult with your healthcare provider before starting any new exercise program.

Classes & Pricing.q: What's the difference between mat and reformer Pilates?
Classes & Pricing.a: Mat Pilates uses your body weight for resistance and is performed on a mat on the floor. Reformer Pilates uses a specialized machine with springs and pulleys that provides variable resistance. Both are excellent; the reformer allows for more variety and can be easier for beginners to feel proper alignment.
Group classes are 50 minutes, private sessions are 60 minutes. We recommend arriving 5-10 minutes early to settle in and avoid rushing.
Please cancel at least 12 hours before your scheduled class to avoid losing a class from your package or membership. We understand emergencies happen—just let us know as soon as possible.
Yes! We offer 15% off for Indonesian residents with valid ID and students with valid student cards. We also have special intro packages for new clients.

Classes & Pricing.q: How many people are in each class?
Classes & Pricing.a: Our group classes are intentionally small, with a maximum of 6-8 people. This allows for personalized attention and modifications while maintaining an intimate, community atmosphere.

Membership.a: Monthly membership gives you unlimited access to all group classes for a flat monthly rate. It automatically renews each month until you choose to cancel. Members also receive priority booking, exclusive events, and special perks.

Membership.q: Can I pause or cancel my membership?
Membership.a: Yes! You can pause your membership for up to 2 weeks per year with 7 days advance notice. Cancellations require 30 days notice. We want you to feel flexible and supported in your practice.

Membership.q: Can I share my class package with someone else?
Membership.a: Class packages can be shared with one family member. Monthly memberships are personal and non-transferable.
Members receive unlimited classes, priority booking, 10% off workshops and merchandise, complimentary mat storage, exclusive member events, and one free private session per year.

Studio & Location.a: We're in the heart of Pererenan, Bali, on Jl. Pantai Pererenan. We're about 10 minutes from Canggu by scooter, easily accessible from Echo Beach, Batu Bolong, and surrounding areas.
Monday-Friday: 6:00 AM - 8:00 PM / Saturday: 7:00 AM - 6:00 PM / Sunday: 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM / Check our schedule for specific class times.
Yes! We have dedicated scooter parking right outside the studio and limited car parking nearby. Most clients arrive by scooter.
We have changing areas and bathroom facilities. While we don't have full shower facilities, Pilates is a low-impact workout that doesn't typically result in heavy sweating.

Humbl Online.q: What's included in the online subscription?
Humbl Online.a: Unlimited access to our growing library of mat and reformer classes, new content added weekly, downloadable workout plans, and the ability to practice from anywhere at any time.

Humbl Online.q: Can I do reformer classes at home without equipment?
Humbl Online.a: Our online reformer classes are designed for those with access to a reformer at home. However, we also offer mat classes and reformer-inspired mat modifications that you can do with no equipment.

Humbl Online.q: How do I access the online videos?
Humbl Online.a: After subscribing, you'll receive login credentials to access our online platform. Videos can be streamed on any device—phone, tablet, computer, or smart TV.

Humbl Online.q: Can I combine studio classes and online subscription?
Humbl Online.a: Absolutely! Many of our members use online classes to supplement their studio practice. We offer discounted bundles if you want both.

testimonials.author: Tori
testimonials.text:
I came to Humbl as a complete beginner with no idea what to expect from Pilates, and I can honestly say it has been a transformative experience. From day one, the team made it their mission to help me build confidence, and they delivered on that in every single class.
Demi and her team are simply incredible. They bring a level of knowledge and expertise that is immediately apparent, but what sets them apart is how they channel that into a warm, positive learning environment where you never feel intimidated. They have a rare gift for striking the perfect balance — sessions feel both deeply relaxing and genuinely challenging in all the right ways.
The studio itself is intimate, which means you quickly feel like part of the Humbl family rather than just another face in the crowd. That sense of community makes a real difference.
And it would be remiss not to mention the lovely little touch at the end of each class — refreshing water and a delicious treat waiting for you. It's a small thing, but it perfectly captures the care and thoughtfulness that runs through everything Humbl does.
A truly awesome place. Give it a try, you won't regret it!

testimonials.author: Monisha Alexander
testimonials.text:
Words can't describe how perfect Humbl Pilates is. This studio made me fall in love with pilates even more and is a little sanctuary where you feel right at home the second you walk in. Demi's classes are truly the best, most dynamic, challenging and humbling classes I have ever been to.
The atmosphere is also so beautiful. From my first class, Demi and staff made me feel right at home — with all the thoughtful touches of remembering your name, feedback in every class, and taking care and consideration for injuries etc, something in my experience a lot of other studios lack. There are only 5 reformers, so you're not just another number in a room. The space is intimate and you can actually progress and see a difference class to class.
I remember coming to my first class on their opening weekend and now they will never get rid of me! Best decision I ever made!

testimonials.author: Jessica Chen
testimonials.text: First class back post-ACL knee injury—and I couldn’t have asked for a better restart! Demi was incredible—so attentive, knowledgeable, and encouraging throughout the session. It was my first time moving again since my knee injury from padel, and I felt completely supported. Loved the small group setup (only 5 reformers!) which made it feel personal and intimate. The flow was thoughtfully challenging—enough to feel the burn, but still safe and sustainable. Demi gave active, hands-on feedback and kept a close eye on our form throughout.  I also got to try several Pilates tools that were totally new to me - Demi explained how to use each one with ease and confidence. It felt like a private masterclass in movement. Felt stronger and more inspired to return.

testimonials.author: Olivia
testimonials.text: The most amazing time for my first Reformer class! Demi is a great instructor, she's very friendly and encouraging, and takes the time to fully explain the moves and help you fix your posture/movement if needed. The "Find Your Passion" class is perfect for beginners and the fact that there are only 5 reformers really creates a cosy, intimate atmosphere, which makes you comfortable right away

testimonials.author: Bhavana
testimonials.text: We just had our first private class at Humbl Pilates, and wow — what an incredible experience! From the moment we walked in, we were struck by how aesthetic and serene the studio felt — every detail has been so thoughtfully curated.

aboutPage.heroSubtitle: Where precision meets personalization in the heart of Pererenan
story: Humbl Pilates was born from a simple belief: that transformative movement should feel personal, intentional, and accessible. Founded in the heart of Pererenan, Bali, we created a space where the precision of classical Pilates meets the warmth of a home-like studio environment.

We chose Pererenan for its unique blend of tranquility and vibrant community energy. Away from the bustling tourist centers, yet close enough to Canggu's creative spirit, our location reflects our philosophy: grounded, authentic, and focused on what truly matters.

Every detail of Humbl has been thoughtfully designed—from our intimate class sizes to the precise calibration of our equipment—to ensure you receive the attention and guidance you deserve. This isn't just another Pilates studio; it's a community dedicated to your personal growth and well-being.

methodPrinciples.title: Mind-Body Connection

founder_REQUIRES_VERIFICATION.title: Meet Demi Geary
paragraphs: Demi brings over a decade of experience in movement education, blending biomechanical principles with contemporary Pilates techniques to create transformative sessions that honor each individual's unique body and goals.

Her journey into Pilates began during her own recovery from a sports injury, where she discovered the profound impact of mindful, precise movement. This experience shaped her teaching philosophy: that true strength comes from understanding your body, not pushing past its limits.

With certifications in Classical and Contemporary Pilates, as well as specialized training in pre/postnatal movement and injury rehabilitation, Demi creates an inclusive environment where everyone—from complete beginners to advanced practitioners—feels supported and challenged.
founder_REQUIRES_VERIFICATION.quote: "Movement should empower, not intimidate. At Humbl, we create space for you to explore your body's potential with curiosity, patience, and expert guidance." — Demi Geary
